title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 2: Y'all Mine Now

scenes.say: Army boot camp. Georgia. A military bus door creaks open.
scenes.visual: a military bus door opening at a boot camp in Georgia, morning heat, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Drill Sergeant Mack starts yelling before the first boot hits the ground.
scenes.visual: a drill sergeant in a campaign hat shouting, low angle silhouette, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Welcome to the United States Army! Y'all think this is a game? Y'all mine now!
scenes.visual: new recruits spilling off a bus into formation, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali steps off last. Unsure. But determined.
scenes.visual: a young recruit stepping off a bus last, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: This ain't redemption. It's war. And war don't care where you from.
scenes.visual: an empty parade field under a hard sky, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: That night, Ali stares at the barracks ceiling. A cadence echoes across the base.
scenes.visual: a recruit lying on a bunk staring at the ceiling, dark barracks, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Yo, you from Jersey? It's Roddy. Nineteen. A white kid from Kentucky.
scenes.visual: two bunks facing each other in a dark barracks, a grin in shadow, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Bet y'all got good pizza. And bad cops. Facts.
scenes.visual: two recruits laughing quietly on bunks, faces in shadow, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
two pairs of boots lined up under neighboring bunks, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Didn't know it then. But that bunk was my first taste of brotherhood.
scenes.visual: moonlight through a barracks window over rows of bunks, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Three. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: dog tags hanging from a bunk rail, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 2 of 25: Y'all Mine Now. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
